title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, Straight Bar | Pink | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with this 30-Inch wall mount towel bar from the Carolina Collection in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. Crafted from solid brass and styled as a straight bar, it keeps bath towels handy while the wall-mounted design helps save space.

Highlights:
- Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Includes mounting plates and all installation hardware
- Coordinates with Carolina Collection pieces for matching transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Diameter: 0.75 in
- Dimensions: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
